headline: Clean: the only Rho-Bank card that beats the competitor's 8% cash back with no foreign fees is the Platinum Rewards Card, so the retention path is unique.
solution_check: Closure checks find a $0 balance with no disputes or replacements. Closure history is empty and found_better_card is logged. A KB scan of all card earn rates finds Platinum Rewards (10% on everything, 0% FX, $200 fee with first-year $0 promo per platinum_009) as the only card above 8% on all purchases (Diamond Elite is 5%; Business Silver is 10% only on travel/software with a 1.5% FX fee). The customer applies with income 145000 and no subscription, and no card is closed. This matches gold.
prior_note: The prior review found it clean. The required doc platinum_rewards_card_002 changed only its title, from 'Earning 4% Cash Back' to 'Earning 10% Cash Back', which removes an internal contradiction.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against snapshot: EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and requires equal agent+user DB hashes (in this domain both toolkits share one TransactionalDB, so the two hashes are identical); _derive_read_log_allowlist logs discoverable READ calls only when gold calls them, but discoverable WRITE calls are logged by tool name even when the tool returns an error string; numbers in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool are parsed with parse_int=float; get_now() = 2025-11-14 03:40:00. unlock_discoverable_agent_tool is in-memory only and never hashed. apply_for_credit_card normalizes annual_income to float, so 145000 and 145000.0 hash the same.
